headline: US-Iran Tensions and New Raids on Gaza: Trump Threatens Harsh Action, Oil Above $103 a Barrel
summary: Trump threatens action against Iran as the United States weighs involvement in the Fairford case. Brent rose to $103.53 a barrel amid the tensions.
why: Brent is the main global benchmark for crude oil, and Middle East supply risks directly affect its price.
why_moved: Brent rose to $103.53 as Trump threatened action against Iran and the US weighed involvement in the Fairford case, raising Middle East supply risk.
